regions.label: Delta Coast
regions.terrain: coastal tidewater — estuary, levees, shotgun porches

regions.label: Amplified Range
regions.terrain: high mountains — basalt cliffs, feedback storms

regions.label: Steel Foothills
regions.terrain: foothills - slide scarps, steel terraces, bottleneck switchbacks

regions.label: Heartland
regions.terrain: farmland plains — wheat, gravel roads, grain towers

regions.label:
Secondline
Riverlands
regions.terrain: riverside port — wharves, brass balconies, paddle steam

regions.label: Quiet Woods
regions.terrain: forest and lakes — pine shade, cabin lights, still water

regions.label: Outer Isles
regions.terrain: offshore archipelago continuing the range's line north - ferry weather, distant genres

waterways.label: The Big Muddy
waterways.note: rises at the heel where the massif's short torrents gather below the Steel Foothills, then runs the body's southeast seam to the bay that bites the bottom curve

waterways.label: Slowhand Creek
waterways.note: short run out of the forest lake on the upper bout, joining the Big Muddy at the seam

waterways.label: The Source
waterways.note: lake in the Quiet Woods at the creek's source; sits where a neck pickup would

waterways.label: The Shoulder Lakes
waterways.note: the two big lakes on the upper bout's shoulder; each carries a sizable Quiet Woods settlement on its shore

waterways.label: The Parade
waterways.note: the second river into the bay, draining the knob-lake country along the lower bout; Second Line's twin waterfront with the Big Muddy

waterways.label: The Knob Lakes
waterways.note: two small lakes on the lower bout, roughly where the knobs would sit

waterways.label: The Wide Water
waterways.note: the southern sea below the body's bottom curve; the bay opens off it

waterways.label: The North Reach
waterways.note: the northern sea flanking the neck; the Outer Isles are the pegs off the headstock

waterways.label: The West Water
waterways.note: open sea west of the body; fjord fingers cut the waist on the northwest side

waterways.label: The East Shore
waterways.note: the sea southeast of the neck; its cut toward the bay defines the body's seam side
